- Overestimate prices in bullish sentiment periods (sentiment > 0.27) — model tends to overshoot, especially after spikes.
- Underestimate prices in bearish sentiment (sentiment < 0.18) — model is overly conservative, missing upward momentum.
- Lag in price corrections: model often delays downward revisions after sentiment shifts to negative or neutral.
- Mean reversion bias: model overcorrects after sharp spikes, leading to overprediction of subsequent declines.
- Horizon-specific error: 30-day forecasts consistently overpredict early in the window (first 5–7 days) when sentiment is volatile.
- Avoid extrapolating recent trends if sentiment reverses — model often ignores sentiment shifts and continues trend extrapolation.
